name: auth-auth0
title: Auth — Auth0
description: Sign in with Auth0 for Lunora auth. Wires Auth0 as an OIDC provider via better-auth's genericOAuth plugin, on top of the base `auth` item.
docs: Add `auth0` to your auth instance's `plugins` array in lunora/auth/index.ts: `import { auth0 } from "./auth0.js"` then `plugins: [auth0(env)]`. Create a Regular Web Application in the Auth0 studio, set the Allowed Callback URL to `<BETTER_AUTH_URL>/api/auth/oauth2/callback/auth0`, and fill in AUTH0_CLIENT_ID / AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET / AUTH0_DOMAIN.

envVars.name: AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Client ID from your Auth0 Regular Web Application.

envVars.name: AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Client Secret from your Auth0 Regular Web Application.

envVars.name: AUTH0_DOMAIN
envVars.description: Your Auth0 tenant domain, e.g. your-tenant.us.auth0.com (no scheme). The provider discovers endpoints from `https://<domain>/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
